Name: Buggy Bugs
Author: w8AwA8w
Description:
Buggy Bugs is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature In The Valley[/url].

Adds 6 new (maybe somewhat annoying) animals to Nature In The Valley. The fly, mosquito, cockroach, termite, yellowjacket and bumblebee.

Some of these are found in peoples homes / the farmhouse.

More information on where to find these creatures can be seen in the creature encyclopedia.

There is a config to disable the creatures which spawn in people's homes (Cockroach and termite)

Downloads.Description: Main file for the mod. Includes content pack and NITV pack.
